newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Nigeria's Kaduna oil refinery unit breaks down.
newsitem.headline: Nigeria's Kaduna oil refinery unit breaks down.

text.p: The fluid catalytic cracking (FCC) unit of Nigeria's Kaduna refinery in the north has broken down due to old age, the state news agency NAN reported on Friday.
It said although the FCC unit at the 110,000 barrels per day (bpd) was rehabilitated last year, most of its components needed to be replaced.
An official of the facility said since 1992, the refinery had not undergone any turnaround maintenance as regularly required for such a plant.
In all Nigeria has four oil refineries, which operate at a fraction of their installed capacity because of frequent breakdowns and lack of funds to repair them.

The result has been intermitent fuel shortage in Africa's leading oil-producing nation, a situation which last month forced the government to resume the import of fuel products with a promise to revamp the refineries.
